text: Robie Harris's It's Perfectly Normal, published in 1994, was challenged in Washington in 1996 on the stated grounds that it encouraged children to desire sexual gratification and was a clear example of child pornography. In 2005 a parent challenged it as sexually explicit at the Holt Middle School parent library in Fayetteville, AR, but the book was retained. It was removed from school district library shelves in Clover Park, Washington. A group of residents in Charlestown, Pennsylvania, unsuccessfully challenged it, asking that it be removed from the children's section at Chester County Public Library. Belarus banned it in 2025 by adding it to the Official List of Publications Harmful to National Interests.
